note: Derived data from a third-party app; untrusted, kept to match behaviour. Rust packs string literals back to back, so one Ghidra string can hold several literals; 'entries' splits them at the boundaries the scope syntax makes clear.

rea.command: rea search Conductor.app/Contents/MacOS/conductor --pattern='\$(HOME|APP[A-Z]*|RESOURCE)/|sqlite:|tauri-plugin-(fs|shell|sql|http|updater)' --mode regex --provider ghidra --snapshot snap/conductor-search.snap --format json

fs_scope.ours: The 13 entries plus a $HOME/** base. The search found no $HOME/** literal, so Conductor's base grant is something the pattern cannot match (likely a bare **); we keep the narrower $HOME/**.

sidecar_path.ours: Not granted: no frontend call site names sidecar-runtime or this path, and OpenConductor ships no sidecar there yet.

fs_watch_feature: Conductor links notify-8.2.0 and notify-debouncer-full-0.5.0 (evidence/ipc/rust-crates-from-paths.txt), which tauri-plugin-fs pulls in only with its watch feature, and the frontend calls plugin:fs|watch and unwatch. We enable features = ["watch"].

sql.ours: sql:allow-load, allow-select, allow-execute, allow-close (the four commands the frontend calls); the sql plugin has no path scope.

shell_scope.source: Decoded embedded frontend (assets/index-BGEQ8YjU.js, assets/renderApp-D_fmY7hW.js, the tree REA analyze-javascript-application read). Command.create names and arguments at every call site.

names.exec-zsh: args ["-c", <script>] at every site (scripts, PATH-prefixed git commands, caffeinate -i, pmset -g batt, the sidecar launch)
names.exec-bash: args ["-c", <script>], used instead of exec-zsh on Linux
names.exec-open: args [<workspace path>] (Open in Finder from the unarchive-conflict toast)

shell_scope.ours: Each name is scoped to -c plus one script argument (exec-open: one path). cmd paths are /bin/zsh, /bin/bash, /usr/bin/open; a second REA search for the names and their cmd values (search_plugin_scopes2) was still running when this was written.

http_scope.source: Decoded frontend: the plugin:http|fetch wrapper (mdt) has one caller, the app-wide fetch function nl, which every network call goes through, so Conductor's scope must admit arbitrary hosts.

updater: Not registered here; it needs an update signing key and endpoint.
